description: Defines data structures, enums, and request/response message formats for UE context update procedures in F1AP protocol within 5G NR network management, including setup, modification, release, and success indication messages.

classes.name: f1ap_cell_ul_cfg
classes.description: Enumeration for uplink configuration options for a cell.

classes.name: f1ap_cu_to_du_rrc_info_ext_ies_container
classes.description: Container for extended information elements in RRC info.

classes.name: f1ap_cu_to_du_rrc_info
classes.description: Structure holding RRC configuration info from CU to DU.

classes.name: f1ap_candidate_sp_cell_item
classes.description: Represents a candidate secondary cell item with its global ID.

classes.name: f1ap_drx_cycle
classes.description: DRX cycle configuration parameters.

classes.name: f1ap_scell_to_be_setup_mod_item
classes.description: Information for a secondary cell to be set up.

classes.name: f1ap_rat_freq_prio_info
classes.description: Information about RAT frequency priority.

classes.name: f1ap_res_coordination_transfer_info
classes.description: Information for res coordination transfer.

classes.name: f1ap_conditional_inter_du_mobility_info
classes.description: Conditional inter-du mobility info with trigger and target UE ID.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_context_setup_request
classes.description: Request to initiate UE context setup procedure.

classes.name: f1ap_du_to_cu_rrc_info
classes.description: RRC info from DU to CU.

classes.name: f1ap_scell_failed_to_setup_mod_item
classes.description: Failed to setup secondary cell item with optional cause.

classes.name: f1ap_srbs_setup_mod_item
classes.description: Setup info for SRB to be configured.

classes.name: f1ap_potential_sp_cell_item
classes.description: Potential secondary cell item with global ID.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_context_setup_response
classes.description: Response after UE context setup, success or failure details.

classes.name: f1ap_tx_action_ind
classes.description: Enumeration for transmission action indication.

classes.name: f1ap_rrc_recfg_complete_ind
classes.description: Indicates whether RRC reconfiguration is complete or failed.

classes.name: f1ap_scell_to_be_remd_item
classes.description: Secondary cell to be remapped.

classes.name: f1ap_rlc_fail_ind
classes.description: Indication of RLC failure with associated LCID.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_context_modification_request
classes.description: Request to modify UE context.

classes.name: f1ap_associated_scell_item
classes.description: Associated secondary cell item.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_context_modification_response
classes.description: Response after UE context modification, success or failure.

classes.name: f1ap_ue_context_release_request
classes.description: Request to release UE context.

classes.name: f1ap_access_success
classes.description: Indicates successful access of UE to target cell.
